about: Case 175's setup, after a rename. An earlier run's b1-u1 (kept, pointer-written) sent the rowing line to Ideas/idea-tobias.md for the comment under it, and b1-u2 (undone) sent it to idea-mara; the line and the comment stayed off the handled list. Since then the writer renamed Ideas/idea-tobias.md to Ideas/idea-tobias-rowing.md, and Obsidian rewrote the line's pointer. This run's scan finds the rename from the copy inside the renamed note (its entry names the old path), so batches.json `renamed` holds it, and hands the rowing line and the comment back. This run's u1, for the same comment, copies the line to idea-mara and a second time into idea-tobias-rowing, the note its pointer now names. The earlier unit's copy into the old path counts as a copy into the new one, so `record` refuses: exit 1 naming u1, Ideas/idea-tobias-rowing.md, and the source line (run three times, one stderr check each). Nothing changes: the run stays at migrating.
